# Fixture P3-FAIL-CAUSAL-ORDER Storyboard

01. A red rope crosses a foggy trail; no sign or warning is visible.
02. Bo steps over the rope to take a shortcut.
03. A companion points out a sign on the far side: “Do not cross the boundary.”
04. The trail disappears and a bell rings behind the hikers, with no established link to the crossing.
05. The group turns back; no rule or prevention choice is resolved.
